description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon3d/rules/ppm_D_lev_noflux_bc (conservative flux-form vertical PPM, Colella-Woodward 1984 non-uniform 4th-order reconstruction, no-flux top/surface) driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_vertical_ppm.esm, with passive lon (NLON=8) and lat (NLAT=5). Loaded once per resolution binding NLEV; pe / dz / w_edge re-derive from NLEV each rebinding. Forced-steady u*=cos(pi z) transported by w=sin(pi z) (vanishing at both walls -> exact no-flux mass conservation); the t=0.1 drift is the flux-divergence truncation on the quadratic-stretch mesh, verified clean 4th-order in BOTH L2 and Linf (the UNLIMITED CW84 reconstruction; the monotonicity limiter is a documented follow-on that would clip smooth extrema and lower this order). expected_order and order_tolerance are set from the Julia golden.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
